entries.original: **`dag retry`** returns failed, cancelled, and skip-cascaded nodes to a fresh attempt while every completed node keeps its cached result. Prompt-corrected retries (`retry` + `prompt`) are supported for exactly one node.
entries.translated: **`dag retry`** returns failed, cancelled, and skip-cascaded nodes to a fresh attempt while every completed node keeps its cached result. Prompt-corrected retries (`retry` + `prompt`) are supported for exactly one node.

entries.original: **`dag send`** routes a message to one node's child with real delivery semantics — `steer` into a running child, `revive` a finished-but-resident child with its context intact, `queued` with a durable queue position when the child cannot take it yet. Non-continuable children get typed refusals (`node_not_continuable`, `node_has_no_task`; an unknown node gets `node_not_found`) that name the remedy.
entries.translated: **`dag send`** routes a message to one node's child with real delivery semantics — `steer` into a running child, `revive` a finished-but-resident child with its context intact, `queued` with a durable queue position when the child cannot take it yet. Non-continuable children get typed refusals (`node_not_continuable`, `node_has_no_task`; an unknown node gets `node_not_found`) that name the remedy.

entries.original: **`dag amend`** accepts an edited definition against the same run, SHA-256-fingerprint-diffs every node, and re-runs only changed + added nodes plus their transitive dependents. `load_skills` is deliberately outside the fingerprint, so a skills-only edit re-runs nothing.
entries.translated: **`dag amend`** accepts an edited definition against the same run, SHA-256-fingerprint-diffs every node, and re-runs only changed + added nodes plus their transitive dependents. `load_skills` is deliberately outside the fingerprint, so a skills-only edit re-runs nothing.

entries.original: Per-node result artifacts are written atomically (temp file + fsync + rename), so a crash mid-retry can no longer leave a truncated result a reader would trust.
entries.translated: Per-node result artifacts are written atomically (temp file + fsync + rename), so a crash mid-retry can no longer leave a truncated result a reader would trust.

entries.original: Three new journaled event types — `dag.node.retried`, `dag.node.steered`, `dag.definition.amended` — record every deliberate re-run and amendment explicitly in the journal. All strictly additive: `schemaVersion` stays 1, documented in `docs/reference/mass-ulw-protocol.md` with an explicit no-break guarantee.
entries.translated: Three new journaled event types — `dag.node.retried`, `dag.node.steered`, `dag.definition.amended` — record every deliberate re-run and amendment explicitly in the journal. All strictly additive: `schemaVersion` stays 1, documented in `docs/reference/mass-ulw-protocol.md` with an explicit no-break guarantee.

entries.original: The status widget shows an `x<attempt>` badge on re-run nodes; `/dag` shows `amended x<n>` and prefixes node errors with the error **code**. A lost amend race is now a clean `run_still_active` refusal instead of a run wedged on journal replay.
entries.translated: The status widget shows an `x<attempt>` badge on re-run nodes; `/dag` shows `amended x<n>` and prefixes node errors with the error **code**. A lost amend race is now a clean `run_still_active` refusal instead of a run wedged on journal replay.

entries.original: The JS SDK gains `retry`, `send`, and `amend` wrappers, and the mass-ulw skill documents the full refusal matrix.
entries.translated: The JS SDK gains `retry`, `send`, and `amend` wrappers, and the mass-ulw skill documents the full refusal matrix.

entries.original: Dedupe keys are scoped per model; a skipped retry returns its key instead of burning it forever.
entries.translated: Dedupe keys are scoped per model; a skipped retry returns its key instead of burning it forever.

entries.original: Internal fallback retries carry an explicit marker so they stop being discarded as synthetic traffic.
entries.translated: Internal fallback retries carry an explicit marker so they stop being discarded as synthetic traffic.

entries.original: Model identity travels as provider/model **plus variant** through the whole fallback path — your reasoning-effort selection survives a fallback and a recovery.
entries.translated: Model identity travels as provider/model **plus variant** through the whole fallback path — your reasoning-effort selection survives a fallback and a recovery.

entries.original: Watchdog timers are generation-scoped, so a timer from an abandoned attempt can never hijack a later turn.
entries.translated: Watchdog timers are generation-scoped, so a timer from an abandoned attempt can never hijack a later turn.

entries.original: A manual model change resets the fallback watchdog, in-flight retry flag, and the retry-key set.
entries.translated: A manual model change resets the fallback watchdog, in-flight retry flag, and the retry-key set.

entries.original: **omo**: every CI, publish, and platform-build workflow moved from Bun 1.3.14 to **1.4.0** (cache keys included), and the committed omo-senpi extension bundles were regenerated under stable 1.4.0 so the CI freshness gate and your installed extension agree byte-for-byte.
entries.translated: **omo**: every CI, publish, and platform-build workflow moved from Bun 1.3.14 to **1.4.0** (cache keys included), and the committed omo-senpi extension bundles were regenerated under stable 1.4.0 so the CI freshness gate and your installed extension agree byte-for-byte.

entries.translated: **senpi 2026.8.20-2** (same-day re-release on top of 2026.8.20): the compiled `senpi` binary is now built with Bun **1.4.0 stable** (was 1.3.14), and npm publishing graduated from the Bun canary channel to stable 1.4.

entries.original: **Safe dependency refresh** riding along — omo: posthog-node 5.49, puppeteer-core 25.8, @clack/prompts 1.7, MCP SDK 1.30, js-yaml 4.3.1, picomatch 4.0.5, bun-types 1.4.0; senpi: Biome 2.5.9, @types/node 26.2.0, vitest + coverage 4.1.11, AWS Bedrock/Smithy patches, protobuf 2.14.0. Deliberately excluded: anything major, the Anthropic SDKs (OAuth-lane sensitivity), @google/genai, @mistralai.
entries.translated: **Safe dependency refresh** riding along — omo: posthog-node 5.49, puppeteer-core 25.8, @clack/prompts 1.7, MCP SDK 1.30, js-yaml 4.3.1, picomatch 4.0.5, bun-types 1.4.0; senpi: Biome 2.5.9, @types/node 26.2.0, vitest + coverage 4.1.11, AWS Bedrock/Smithy patches, protobuf 2.14.0. entries.original: **`/resume` no longer stalls on big sessions**: exact byte-bounded streaming summaries are reused for unchanged files, and the visible transcript tail paints first while older messages warm progressively.
entries.translated: **`/resume` no longer stalls on big sessions**: exact byte-bounded streaming summaries are reused for unchanged files, and the visible transcript tail paints first while older messages warm progressively.

entries.original: **Startup sheds 680 modules**: the 1.2 MB Claude Agent SDK bundle and the jsdom/Readability/turndown HTML stack now load on first use, not at boot (14,203 → 13,523 modules).
entries.translated: **Startup sheds 680 modules**: the 1.2 MB Claude Agent SDK bundle and the jsdom/Readability/turndown HTML stack now load on first use, not at boot (14,203 → 13,523 modules).

entries.original: **One process lighter per launch**: `cli.ts` runs the agent in-process unless an Inspector option or custom exec args genuinely require a child (measured -75 ms, -6.2% on `--help`).
entries.translated: **One process lighter per launch**: `cli.ts` runs the agent in-process unless an Inspector option or custom exec args genuinely require a child (measured -75 ms, -6.2% on `--help`).

entries.original: **On-disk compile cache**: Node's `enableCompileCache()` is on for both CLI entries and published to children, so second launches skip recompiling the engine graph.
entries.translated: **On-disk compile cache**: Node's `enableCompileCache()` is on for both CLI entries and published to children, so second launches skip recompiling the engine graph.

entries.original: **Hot reload off the critical path**: recursive config watchers run in a worker thread on macOS too, watcher teardown leaves the reload path (1.5–62 s of shutdown stall eliminated), and MCP reconnect no longer blocks a reload.
entries.translated: **Hot reload off the critical path**: recursive config watchers run in a worker thread on macOS too, watcher teardown leaves the reload path (1.5–62 s of shutdown stall eliminated), and MCP reconnect no longer blocks a reload.

entries.original: **Watch scope fixed**: recursive watch targets now open one non-recursive subscription per in-scope directory — an extensions dir containing `node_modules` no longer drives `fseventsd` to 123% CPU and multi-GB RSS.
entries.translated: **Watch scope fixed**: recursive watch targets now open one non-recursive subscription per in-scope directory — an extensions dir containing `node_modules` no longer drives `fseventsd` to 123% CPU and multi-GB RSS.

entries.original: **Retry spinners throttle** on sessions with 1,000+ persisted entries; the countdown stays.
entries.translated: **Retry spinners throttle** on sessions with 1,000+ persisted entries; the countdown stays.

entries.original: Goal footer tickers retire themselves on a stale extension context instead of ticking dead forever — the "Pursuing goal" label and continuation countdown no longer freeze the session after a reload.
entries.translated: Goal footer tickers retire themselves on a stale extension context instead of ticking dead forever — the "Pursuing goal" label and continuation countdown no longer freeze the session after a reload.

entries.original: TUI mode switches detach live components instead of disposing them; spinners and widget intervals survive the switch.
entries.translated: TUI mode switches detach live components instead of disposing them; spinners and widget intervals survive the switch.

entries.original: A vetoed or failed `/reload` no longer destroys live extension footers and task widgets.
entries.translated: A vetoed or failed `/reload` no longer destroys live extension footers and task widgets.

entries.original: Assistant text that arrives after the last tool call renders below the tool cards, so approval questions stay visible.
entries.translated: Assistant text that arrives after the last tool call renders below the tool cards, so approval questions stay visible.

entries.original: 0-token `resource_exhausted` is treated as overflow: surface on first failure → compact before any rotation; rotation persists under the agent dir and survives TUI restarts; a rotation skip at the 3-rotation cap remints a fresh wire id instead of poisoning the session.
entries.translated: 0-token `resource_exhausted` is treated as overflow: surface on first failure → compact before any rotation; rotation persists under the agent dir and survives TUI restarts; a rotation skip at the 3-rotation cap remints a fresh wire id instead of poisoning the session.

entries.original: Same-model retry after remint/compact instead of falling back to another provider; too-small overflow compacts drop to the last user turn; implausible billed `cacheRead` (3×/8× the live window) can no longer force useless compacts.
entries.translated: Same-model retry after remint/compact instead of falling back to another provider; too-small overflow compacts drop to the last user turn; implausible billed `cacheRead` (3×/8× the live window) can no longer force useless compacts.

entries.original: Mid-turn compaction refuses while a native Run is live, so `conversationId` can't get poisoned mid-flight.
entries.translated: Mid-turn compaction refuses while a native Run is live, so `conversationId` can't get poisoned mid-flight.

entries.original: Turns that end `stop` with pending toolCalls continue as `toolUse`; turns idle after completed tools end normally instead of hanging to the idle timeout.
entries.translated: Turns that end `stop` with pending toolCalls continue as `toolUse`; turns idle after completed tools end normally instead of hanging to the idle timeout.

entries.original: ANTML invoke recovery is skipped on `cursor-agent`, so Claude-named Cursor models stop rejecting parallel tool starts.
entries.translated: ANTML invoke recovery is skipped on `cursor-agent`, so Claude-named Cursor models stop rejecting parallel tool starts.

entries.original: Native `todo` calls persist even when the server resolves them without a local op; late `tool_execution_end` events draw their card instead of orphaning results; streamed task args survive an empty `{}` completion.
entries.translated: Native `todo` calls persist even when the server resolves them without a local op; late `tool_execution_end` events draw their card instead of orphaning results; streamed task args survive an empty `{}` completion.

entries.original: Explicit thinking levels resolve to catalog suffix variant ids (`claude-fable-5-thinking-low`) on both the native and CLI lanes — no more `Connect error not_found`.
entries.translated: Explicit thinking levels resolve to catalog suffix variant ids (`claude-fable-5-thinking-low`) on both the native and CLI lanes — no more `Connect error not_found`.

entries.original: Exec-bridge ownership is airtight: handlers bind to the owning run's abort signal, fail closed without a captured run, re-check ownership after approval prompts, and emit `tool_execution_end` errors so nothing dangles.
entries.translated: Exec-bridge ownership is airtight: handlers bind to the owning run's abort signal, fail closed without a captured run, re-check ownership after approval prompts, and emit `tool_execution_end` errors so nothing dangles.

entries.original: Session titles use the session model's own summarization auth — no more `unauthenticated` title calls under an explicit compaction model.
entries.translated: Session titles use the session model's own summarization auth — no more `unauthenticated` title calls under an explicit compaction model.

entries.original: Goal continuations are **append-only**: per-request history rewriting invalidated the provider's cache prefix, so long team-mode sessions paid a full uncached re-read every turn and drove themselves into 429 storms.
entries.translated: Goal continuations are **append-only**: per-request history rewriting invalidated the provider's cache prefix, so long team-mode sessions paid a full uncached re-read every turn and drove themselves into 429 storms.

entries.original: Same-model 429 retries floor every wait with the exponential schedule — a provider answering with the same tiny `retry-after` hint can't pin the cadence at milliseconds anymore.
entries.translated: Same-model 429 retries floor every wait with the exponential schedule — a provider answering with the same tiny `retry-after` hint can't pin the cadence at milliseconds anymore.
